targets.rawSql:
SELECT number AS "#", ticket_id AS "ticket", status,
  steps_done || '/8' AS "progress", COALESCE(current_step,'') AS "now",
  category, urgency, decision, queue, reasons,
  COALESCE(agent_decision,'open') AS "agent", COALESCE(agent_name,'') AS "by",
  attempts, round(queue_seconds::numeric,2) AS "queue s", round(processing_seconds::numeric,2) AS "processing s",
  created_at AS "received"
FROM tickets_monitoring ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Live from Postgres (view tickets_monitoring, read-only role): never the message, draft or final text. Use the column filters. Open a ticket's full detail with GET /tickets/{number} (agent key).

targets.rawSql: SELECT status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM tickets_monitoring GROUP BY status

panels.title: Agent decisions on co-pilot drafts

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(agent_decision,'open') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE status='done' GROUP BY 1

panels.description: sent = draft sent unchanged · edited = agent changed it · manual = handled without the draft · open = not handled yet

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(max(extract(epoch FROM now()-created_at)),0) AS seconds FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE status IN ('queued','processing')
SELECT count(*) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE status='done' AND agent_decision IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE status='failed'

panels.title: Edit rate (edited / decided)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum((agent_decision='edited')::int)::float / NULLIF(sum((agent_decision IN ('sent','edited'))::int),0),0) AS edit_rate FROM tickets_monitoring

panels.description: Quality metric (PRD §6b): how often agents change the co-pilot's draft before sending. Falling = better drafts.

panels.title: One ticket: status and PII masking (pick Ticket # at the top, or click a # in the table above)

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket
SELECT COALESCE(decision,'—') || ' → ' || COALESCE(queue,'—') AS route FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket
SELECT pii_count FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.title: Possible misses (residual)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN pii_residual = '[]' THEN 'none' ELSE pii_residual END AS residual FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.description: Text that still LOOKS like PII after masking (e.g. a mistyped card that fails the checksum). Should be 'none'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pii_ms FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket
SELECT COALESCE(agent_decision || ' by ' || agent_name, 'open (no agent yet)') AS agent FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.title: How it was masked: one row per detected PII span (never the value)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT field, placeholder, type, recognizer, round(score::numeric, 2) AS score, chars,
  CASE WHEN recognizer = 'MultilingualNameRecognizer' THEN 'model (GLiNER, multilingual)'
       WHEN recognizer IN ('CreditCardRecognizer','IbanRecognizer') THEN 'pattern + checksum'
       WHEN recognizer = 'PhoneRecognizer' THEN 'pattern + phone-number validation'
       WHEN recognizer IN ('DocumentNumberRecognizer','AccountNumberRecognizer') THEN 'pattern + context word'
       ELSE 'pattern' END AS method
FROM tickets_pii_detections WHERE number = $ticket ORDER BY field DESC, placeholder

panels.description: Placeholders replace the values before anything else sees the ticket (LLM, graph, LangSmith, logs). Real values: encrypted vault, 30-day expiry, agent access audited.

panels.title: Timeline

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'received (API: masked + queued)' AS event, created_at AS at, NULL::numeric AS seconds FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket
UNION ALL SELECT 'worker started (attempt ' || attempts || ')', started_at, round(queue_seconds::numeric,3) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket AND started_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'workflow finished (' || steps_done || '/8 steps' || COALESCE(', now: ' || current_step,'') || ')', finished_at, round(processing_seconds::numeric,3) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket AND finished_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'agent: ' || agent_decision || ' by ' || agent_name, decided_at, NULL FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket AND decided_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY at

panels.description: seconds = time since the previous event (queue wait, processing).

panels.title: Ticket journey: API → PII masking → queue → workflow (path taken in green, time per step)

targets.rawSql:
WITH g(id, title, ord) AS (VALUES
  ('start','POST /tickets (API)',0),('pii_mask','pii_mask (API, BEFORE the graph)',1),('queue','queue (Postgres)',2),
  ('classify','classify (LLM 1)',3),('policy_gate','policy_gate (hard rules)',4),('retrieve','retrieve (KB search)',5),
  ('template_reply','template_reply (decline / ack)',5),('draft','draft (LLM 2)',6),('post_check','post_check (numbers, citations)',7),
  ('compose','compose',8),('route','route (who handles it)',9),('audit','audit',10),('end','done',11)),
t AS (SELECT * FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket),
s AS (SELECT node, sum(ms) AS ms, count(*) AS runs FROM tickets_steps WHERE number = $ticket GROUP BY node)
SELECT g.id, g.title,
  CASE
    WHEN g.id = 'start' THEN (SELECT ticket_id FROM t)
    WHEN g.id = 'pii_mask' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(round(pii_ms)::text || ' ms · ' || pii_count || ' PII masked', 'no data') FROM t)
    WHEN g.id = 'queue' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(round(queue_seconds::numeric * 1000) || ' ms waiting', 'waiting…') FROM t)
    WHEN g.id = 'end' THEN (SELECT status FROM t)
    WHEN s.node IS NULL THEN 'not taken'
    ELSE round(s.ms::numeric, 1) || ' ms' END AS mainstat,
  CASE
    WHEN g.id = 'pii_mask' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN pii_residual = '[]' THEN 'no possible misses' ELSE 'possible miss: ' || pii_residual END FROM t)
    WHEN s.runs > 1 THEN s.runs || ' runs (redraft)' ELSE '' END AS secondarystat,
  CASE
    WHEN g.id IN ('start','pii_mask') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t) THEN 1
    WHEN g.id = 'queue' AND (SELECT started_at IS NOT NULL FROM t) THEN 1
    WHEN g.id = 'end' AND (SELECT status IN ('done','failed') FROM t) THEN 1
    WHEN s.node IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS arc__taken
FROM g LEFT JOIN s ON s.node = g.id ORDER BY g.ord

WITH e(id, source, target) AS (VALUES
 ('e0','start','pii_mask'),('e0b','pii_mask','queue'),('e1','queue','classify'),('e2','classify','policy_gate'),
 ('e3','policy_gate','retrieve'),('e4','policy_gate','template_reply'),('e5','retrieve','draft'),('e6','draft','post_check'),
 ('e7','post_check','draft'),('e8','post_check','compose'),('e9','template_reply','compose'),('e10','compose','route'),
 ('e11','route','audit'),('e12','audit','end')),
p AS (SELECT ord, node FROM tickets_steps WHERE number = $ticket),
t AS (SELECT * FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket),
taken AS (
  SELECT a.node AS source, b.node AS target FROM p a JOIN p b ON b.ord = a.ord + 1
  UNION SELECT 'queue', node FROM p WHERE ord = 1
  UNION SELECT node, 'end' FROM p WHERE node = 'audit'
  UNION SELECT 'start', 'pii_mask' FROM t
  UNION SELECT 'pii_mask', 'queue' FROM t)
SELECT e.id, e.source, e.target, CASE WHEN tk.source IS NOT NULL THEN 'taken' ELSE '' END AS mainstat
FROM e LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT source, target FROM taken) tk ON tk.source = e.source AND tk.target = e.target

panels.description: pii_mask runs in the API BEFORE the LangGraph workflow (D3/D10): raw PII never enters the graph, traces or the LLM. Then the ticket waits in the Postgres queue and a worker runs the graph. policy_gate (hard rules) runs BEFORE any reply is written, post_check AFTER.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ord AS "#", node, round(ms::numeric, 1) AS ms FROM tickets_steps WHERE number = $ticket ORDER BY ord
